signal_basis.exact_text: The current result does not discriminate lock contention from isolated pool exhaustion.
Measure lock-wait duration with pool occupancy next: elevated lock waits with normal occupancy favor lock contention, whereas ordinary lock waits with saturated occupancy favor pool exhaustion.
